projects.title: AI Interview Platform
projects.short_description: An AI-powered interview preparation platform that analyzes resumes, identifies skill gaps, generates personalized learning roadmaps, and conducts mock technical interviews.
projects.description: A comprehensive AI-driven career development platform that helps students prepare for technical interviews through resume analysis, job description matching, skill gap analysis, roadmap generation, and AI-powered interview evaluation.

details.problem: Students often struggle to understand their readiness for target jobs and lack personalized guidance for interview preparation.
details.solution: Developed an AI-powered platform that analyzes resumes and job descriptions, calculates readiness scores, identifies missing skills, generates learning roadmaps, and conducts mock interviews with AI evaluation.
details.challenges: Designing reliable AI workflows and integrating Large Language Models into software engineering processes.

projects.title: Hotel Management System
projects.short_description: A cross-platform hotel management application supporting room booking, customer management, payments, and administrative operations.
projects.description: A mobile hotel management system developed with Flutter and Firebase, supporting booking management, room management, customer management, payment tracking, and administrative dashboards.

details.problem: Small and medium-sized hotels require an affordable digital solution for booking and operational management.
details.solution: Developed a mobile-first hotel management application with Firebase backend and real-time synchronization.
details.challenges: Coordinating a multi-member development team while maintaining a consistent architecture and data contracts.

projects.title: SaleSphere Management System
projects.short_description: An enterprise sales management system supporting product management, inventory, customer management, and sales reporting.
projects.description: A web-based enterprise management system designed to streamline business operations, inventory management, customer management, and reporting.

details.problem: Businesses need a centralized platform to manage products, customers, inventory, and sales activities.
details.solution: Designed and implemented an enterprise management system following modern software engineering practices.
details.challenges: Designing scalable business workflows while maintaining clean and maintainable code.
